name: Standard four-wheel tractor
definition: general-purpose wheeled tractor with a rear power take-off and a Category 1 or larger three-point hitch, made to draw, carry and drive implements; the maker's size label (sub-compact, compact, utility) is `size_class` on the named form.

name: Row-crop tractor
definition: wheeled tractor built with adjustable track and clearance to work between crop rows.

name: Narrow orchard and vineyard tractor [tracteur fruitier, tracteur vigneron, Schmalspurtraktor]
definition: wheeled tractor with a narrow track and low profile, made to work between rows of vines and fruit trees.

name: High-clearance (straddle) tractor [enjambeur]
definition: tractor with high ground clearance that straddles rows of vines or crops.

name: Slope (mower-carrier) tractor [Mähtrak, Bergtrak]
definition: low, wide tractor with a low centre of gravity, made to carry mowers and implements on steep ground.

name: Forestry tractor [tracteur forestier, Forsttraktor]
definition: wheeled tractor built and guarded for forest work such as winching and skidding; filed here by C14(b) and shown in Forestry by a view.

name: Articulated four-wheel-drive tractor
definition: large tractor with four equal driven wheels that steers by bending at a central pivot.

name: Crawler (full-track) tractor
definition: tractor running on two full-length tracks instead of wheels.

name: Half-track tractor (delta tractor)
definition: tractor with front tyres and rear crawler tracks.

name: Two-wheel (walk-behind) tractor (power tiller)
definition: single-axle tractor steered from behind by handles, in C7 only with a rear power take-off and a Category 1 or larger three-point hitch; any other walk-behind tractor or tiller is C2 (K-99).

name: Implement carrier (tool-carrier tractor, no load body)
definition: self-propelled carrier made to carry and drive implements, with no load body; a Unimog with a load bed is G1 (K-93).

name: Mouldboard plough
definition: plough whose curved mouldboards cut and turn the soil over.

name: Chisel and tine cultivator
definition: implement with rigid or sprung tines that loosen the soil without turning it.

name: Disc harrow
definition: implement with gangs of concave discs that cut and mix the surface soil.

name: Power harrow
definition: PTO-driven harrow whose rotating vertical tines break clods into a seedbed.

name: Rotary tiller (rotavator)
definition: PTO-driven implement whose blades on a horizontal rotor churn the soil.

name: Subsoiler and deep ripper
definition: implement with heavy legs that break compacted layers below plough depth.

name: Land roller and packer
definition: roller or packer that firms and levels the soil surface.

name: Spading machine
definition: PTO-driven implement whose spades dig and turn the soil.

name: Puddling harrow (rice paddy)
definition: implement that churns flooded paddy soil into a puddle before transplanting.

name: Seedbed combination
definition: implement that combines tines, levelling bars and rollers to make a seedbed in one pass.

name: Box blade
definition: tractor-mounted open box with a blade and scarifier teeth, for grading and moving soil.

name: Rear grader blade and land leveller
definition: rear-mounted blade or levelling frame for grading, levelling and ditching.

name: Post-hole auger
definition: tractor-driven auger that bores holes for posts and planting.

name: Trencher
definition: tractor-driven implement that cuts narrow trenches.

name: Bund plasterer (rice paddy)
definition: implement that forms and smooths the earth bunds round paddy fields.

name: Tractor snow blade and snow blower
definition: snow blade or blower made to be mounted on or driven from a tractor; C7 whoever buys it (K-99).

name: Seed drill
definition: implement that sows seed in rows at a set rate and depth; tine, disc and no-till coulters are attributes.

name: Precision single-seed planter
definition: planter that places single seeds at a set spacing in the row.

name: Potato planter
definition: implement that plants seed potatoes in ridges.

name: Transplanter
definition: implement that sets seedlings or young plants into the field.

name: Rice transplanter
definition: machine that plants rice seedlings into a flooded paddy; `rows` (4 to 8) is an attribute.

name: Fertiliser spreader
definition: implement that broadcasts or places granular fertiliser.

name: Manure spreader
definition: wagon that shreds and spreads solid manure.

name: Slurry tanker
definition: tank that carries and spreads liquid slurry.

name: Slurry injector
definition: implement that places slurry into the soil.

name: Crop sprayer
definition: sprayer that applies crop-protection liquids through a boom; `carrier` (mounted, trailed, self-propelled) is an attribute.

name: Inter-row hoe and tine weeder
definition: implement that weeds mechanically between and within crop rows.

name: Irrigation reel and sprinkler set
definition: hose reel and field sprinkler line made for field-crop irrigation (K-100).

name: Centre-pivot and linear-move irrigation machine
definition: self-moving span of sprinkler pipe that irrigates a field in a circle or a strip (K-100).

name: Field irrigation pump
definition: pump made to move water for field irrigation (K-175).

name: Combine harvester [moissonneuse-batteuse, Mähdrescher, colheitadeira]
definition: self-propelled machine that reaps, threshes and cleans grain; `threshing_type` (head-feeding, conventional, axial rotor) is an attribute.

name: Combine header [plataforma colheitadeira]
definition: interchangeable front cutting or pick-up unit for a combine harvester.

name: Forage harvester [ensileuse]
definition: machine that cuts and chops forage crops for silage; `carrier` (self-propelled, trailed) is an attribute.

name: Potato harvester
definition: machine that lifts potatoes and separates them from soil and haulm.

name: Sugar-beet harvester
definition: machine that tops, lifts and cleans sugar or fodder beet.

name: Grape harvester
definition: machine that straddles vine rows and shakes off the grapes.

name: Carrot harvester
definition: machine that lifts carrots by their tops.

name: Disc and drum mower
definition: mower whose rotating discs or drums cut grass for hay or silage.

name: Hay tedder
definition: implement with rotating tines that spreads and turns cut grass to dry.

name: Hay rake and windrower
definition: implement that gathers cut grass into windrows.

name: Baler
definition: machine that picks up hay, straw or silage and presses it into round or square bales.

name: Bale wrapper
definition: machine that wraps bales in stretch film for silage.

name: Rotary cutter and flail mower (mulcher)
definition: implement that cuts and shreds standing vegetation on grassland, verges, vineyards and scrub; C7 whoever buys it (K-99).

name: Loader and forage wagon
definition: wagon that picks up, cuts and carries grass or silage.

name: Grain dryer
definition: installation that dries harvested grain.

name: Grain cleaner
definition: machine that separates grain from chaff, weed seed and dirt.

name: Grain conveyor
definition: auger, belt or elevator that moves grain.

name: Rice huller
definition: machine that removes the husk from paddy rice.

name: Bucket milking machine
definition: portable milking unit that milks into a bucket.

name: Pipeline milking installation
definition: milking system that carries the milk from the stalls through a pipeline to the dairy.

name: Static milking parlour
definition: fixed parlour in which cows stand in stalls to be milked; `units_per_stalls` (one per two stalls, one per stall) and `stall_layout` (abreast, herringbone; provisional) are attributes.

name: Rotary milking parlour
definition: parlour whose stalls ride on a rotating platform.

name: Trigon milking parlour
definition: parlour with stalls on three sides of the milker's pit.

name: Polygon milking parlour
definition: parlour with stalls on four sides of the milker's pit.

name: Milking robot
definition: automatic milking system that attaches the cups and milks without a milker.

name: Bulk milk cooling tank
definition: refrigerated tank that cools and holds the milk on the farm.

name: Milk meter
definition: meter that measures each cow's milk yield.

name: Cattle crush and headgate
definition: crate or gate that restrains one animal for treatment.

name: Sheep handler and drafter
definition: race unit that holds, turns or sorts sheep into pens.

name: Livestock weigh-scale indicator
definition: electronic indicator that reads, shows and records livestock weights from load bars or a platform.

name: Livestock weigh platform and load bars
definition: platform or pair of load bars on which animals are weighed.

name: Livestock EID stick reader
definition: handheld reader for livestock electronic ear tags, sold for herd recording; pet microchip scanners are B10 (K-101).

name: Shearing machine
definition: powered machine with its motor and drive that runs a shearing handpiece, for flock-scale shearing.

name: Captive-bolt stunner
definition: tool that stuns livestock by driving a bolt into the skull.

name: Scalder
definition: tank or machine that scalds slaughtered pigs or poultry to loosen hair or feathers.

name: Poultry feeding line
definition: automatic feed line for a commercial poultry house.

name: Egg collection system
definition: belt or conveyor system that collects eggs in a commercial laying house.

name: Commercial hatching incubator
definition: commercial hatcher for eggs at flock scale; small incubators are B10 (K-101).

name: Feed mixer wagon
definition: wagon that mixes and dispenses a feed ration.

name: Silage block cutter
definition: tractor implement that cuts and carries blocks from a silage clamp.

name: Bedding spreader
definition: machine that spreads straw or other bedding in housing.

name: Forest harvester
definition: self-propelled machine that fells, delimbs and cuts trees to length.

name: Forwarder
definition: self-propelled machine that carries cut logs clear of the ground on its own load bed.

name: Skidder
definition: machine that drags felled trees or logs to the roadside.

name: Feller buncher
definition: machine that fells trees and gathers them into bunches; `boom_type` (drive-to-tree, swing-boom) is an attribute.

name: Harvester head
definition: felling, delimbing and cross-cutting head made for a forest harvester or excavator base.

name: Wood chipper
definition: chipper that is tractor-driven (PTO or mounted) or part of a forest machine; a towed or self-propelled tree-surgery chipper is C2 (C7-O1).

name: Forestry mulcher
definition: heavy mulcher that shreds trees, brush and stumps on forest and clearing land.

name: Stump grinder
definition: machine that grinds tree stumps below ground level.

name: Forestry winch
definition: tractor-mounted winch for pulling felled trees and logs.

name: Harwarder
definition: combined forest machine that both harvests trees and forwards the logs.

name: Delimber
definition: machine that strips the limbs from felled trees.

name: Forestry knuckleboom loader
definition: loader with a jointed boom and grapple for lifting and loading logs.

name: Forestry excavator
definition: excavator-based machine built for a forestry job (K-194).

name: Log splitter, tractor-driven (PTO or mounted)
definition: log splitter driven from or mounted on a tractor; hand and engine log splitters are C1 (K-173).

name: Front-end loader
definition: loader arms and frame made to be fitted to a tractor.

name: Loader attachment (pallet forks, bucket, bale spike)
definition: tool made to be fitted to a tractor's front loader.

name: Wheel weight
definition: ballast weight fitted to a tractor wheel.

name: Tractor tyre
definition: tyre made for a tractor.

name: Tractor rim and complete wheel
definition: rim or tyred wheel made for a tractor.

name: Rubber track unit
definition: rubber track system fitted to a tractor in place of wheels.

name: Guidance and auto-steer system
definition: guidance receiver, display or auto-steer kit made for a tractor or farm machine.

name: Shearing handpiece
definition: handpiece that holds and drives the comb and cutter, made for a shearing machine.

name: Shearing comb and cutter
definition: comb and cutter blades made for a shearing handpiece.
